reclassification_apply_rule: Never delete an included source record: move it only after the same PMID/effect has an accepted target-category record; otherwise retain it for adjudication.
parent_rule: Search each parent as its own exposure; add screened child membership after direct screening without creating child-derived parent model contexts.

non_inheriting_relationships.reason: Nicotinamide riboside participates in vitamin B3/NAD+ metabolism but its evidence must remain separate from Vitamin B3, NAD+, NADH, NMN, and NMNH exposures.

additional_catalog_rule: Search every entry in the collision-checked union of additionalExposure.json and additionalExposureV2.json once using its canonical search vocabulary; guarded terms remain guarded.
third_round_gate: INCLUDE and PMCID and (JBI Fair or required quantitative field missing/invalid after Wald or exposure classification ambiguous)
